result.html:
Maadili yanahusiana na tabia za haki na ujinga. Usafi ni kuwa huru kutokana na kosa la kimaadili au hatia, ukionekana kwa uzingatiaji wa uzembe, ambao ni uadilifu wa kibinafsi. Usafi haujumuishi chochote ambacho haki yake siyo sehemu yake. Kama ilivyoonyeshwa na kichwa, makala haya yatakuwa kuhusu kufanya mema na kuwa huru kutokana na kosa la kimaadili na hatia, kuishi maisha ya uadilifu, na kuweka ndani na nje mwetu huru ya chochote ambacho haki yake siyo sehemu yake.

Angalia kile Biblia inasema kuhusu kuwa mweupe. “Blessed are the pure in heart” (Matthew 5:8). “That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere (pure) and without offense till the day of Christ” (Philippians 1:10). “Think on things that are pure” (Philippians 4:8). “Keep thyself pure” (1Timothy 5:22). Revelation 19 says “The pure in heart shall see God.” Psalm 24:3-4 asks “Who shall see God?” The answer is “he that hath clean hands and a pure heart.” Kwa maneno mengine, ni watu ambao wapo safi ndani na nje watakaoona Mungu na kuingia katika uwepo Wake.

Kuishi kwa usafi wa kimaadili haitatokea bila azimio kali na nidhamu. Daima imekuwa hivyo, lakini hata zaidi leo kwa kuongezeka kwa teknolojia na upatikanaji wa uovu kwa urahisi mikononi mwetu.

Mavunjo ya ngono si mambo ya kigeni kwa kanisa. Kwa kweli, hayakuwa kigeni kwa watu wa rangi yoyote. Hatuwezi kupumzika na kuacha ulinzi wetu tukidhani watoto wetu watakuwa salama dhidi ya mabaya ya jamii na ubinadamu wetu. Lazima tuwaonyeshe kwa mfano na kuwafundisha watoto na vijana wetu ikiwa tunatarajia wawe watsafi katika jamii hii iliyo uchafu. Hatuwezi kudhani kwamba mtu akivaa kwa namna fulani, kila kitu ndani ni sawa. Hadithi haiambiwi kwa ukamilifu na muonekano wa nje. Mafarisayo walifanya muonekano wa nje uonekane mzuri, wakati ndani kulikuwa na uharibifu. Yesu alisema, “Cleanse first the inside of the cup and platter that the outside may be clean also” (Matthew 23:26). Hata sisi tunapaswa kutoa kipaumbele kwa matatizo ya moyo. Moyo ukiwa safi, basi nje pia itaweza kusafishwa.

I John 1:6 says, “if we say that we have fellowship with Him and walk in darkness (light on the outside and darkness on the inside), we lie and do not practice the truth.” Giza la ndani daima litaangamiza ushirikiano na kuua mahusiano—kila wakati.

Hii inakusudiwa kuwa ujumbe wa matumaini, sio kukata tamaa. Ikiwa una sehemu ya giza iliyofichika, itikie na uiondoe. Unaweza kuwa huru! Inawezekana kuwa huru kutokana na wavu wa Shetani na kuishi maisha ya uwazi, wazi na furaha ndani ya roho yako. Huna haja ya kuishi njia ya kujaribu kuficha giza la uovu. Yesu anataka kusamehe na kuponya.

Shetani ni mnyanyasaji. In John 10:10, Yesu alisema, “the devil wants to steal, kill, and destroy. He wants to steal your purity, kill your character, and destroy” mahusiano yote ya kimungu. Maslahi yake ni kuvunja nyumba yako, kuharibu heshima yako, na kukutuma kuzimu. Wakati wote, anakurudisha kupitia tamaa za mwili wako, na upanga wake umechomolewa kukufunga na kukuua.

Dhambi za kimaadili ni aibu sana na ngumu kutamka. Jambo la kawaida ni kujaribu kuficha tunapofanya vibaya. Watoto wanaojifunza kuficha maovu mapema maishani kawaida hukua na kuwa vijana wanaoficha vitu kutoka kwa wazazi, walimu shuleni, na makasisi. Mtu huyu atahitaji kujifunza kuwa wazi na waziwazi, au wakati utafika atakapoanza kuficha vitu hata kwa mwenzi wake. Kuficha kunaofanya maisha ya pacha na kusababisha utegemezi zaidi na mahusiano yaliyovunjika. Watu walio na milango iliyofungwa katika pembe fulani za maisha yao watakuwa wenye kumiliki simu zao na wasiotaka kushiriki nywila zao za siri na mwenzi wa kuaminika. Inaonekana tunasahau kwa urahisi jinsi ilivyo bure kuficha kutoka kwa Mungu. Hebrews 4:13 says, “Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom (we will give account to).” Je, tunaweza kuwa wavivu na wajinga kiasi gani kufikiri tunaweza kuficha lolote kwa Mungu? Au kuchukua hatua zaidi: Kwa nini tungependelea kuficha kitu kwake? Numbers 32:23 bado ni kweli sana, ikisema, “Be sure your sin will find you out.” Mungu anakupenda mno kiasi kwamba hatakuacha utiwa wa kuficha kile kinachohitaji kuletwa nje na kusamehewa.

Mavunjo ya ngono pia ni ya udanganyifu mkubwa. Kwa kawaida hutokea jinsi James alivyoiweka kwenye sura ya kwanza. Tunavutwa, tunavutwa mbali, tunavutwa kama sumaku kutoka katikati, tunahisi msukumo wa tamaa, tukihakikisha hakuna mtu anayeangalia, na alama zetu zimefunikwa, hatua zinakaribia marufuku, tamaa inazidi, na kuanza kwa haraka kupoteza uwezo wa kufikiri na kukisia matokeo kama mtu aliyekonywa hadhi, kisha James 1:15 inatokea: “Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death” Verse 16 says, “Do not (be deceived) my beloved brethren.”

James angesema tusitamani kile ambacho si chetu, hata ishara moja. Biblia inatuambia kukimbia vitu vitatu. Moja yao ni ubabaishaji, ambao unaweza kupanuliwa hadi dhambi zote za ngono. Usicheze nayo; usitazame mara ya pili; kimbia! Badilisha mawazo hayo na mawazo yanayojenga ya Mungu na njia Yake. Imba wimbo wa kale; kwa bahati nzuri hatuwezi kufikiri vitu viwili kwa wakati mmoja. Ni chochote itakayochukua, kimbia tamaa hiyo ya tendo la kimahaba. Itakupeleka mbali zaidi ya unavyotaka kwenda na itagharimu zaidi ya unavyotaka kulipa. Endesha filamu hadi mwisho na jiulize, ikiwa nitafuata kilichoniangusha, nitapata kile ninachotaka? Shetani daima ahalalisha raha, lakini kisha analeta maumivu. Kumbuka, Shetani hajawahi kubuni raha; yeye tu huchukua kile Mungu alichotengeneza kuwa safi na kizuri, anakichafua, na kukirudisha kwa sura yake iliyoharibika. Kumbuka, upanga wa Shetani umechomolewa kuua kwa wakati huu. Kimbia tamaa za uovu!

Usifuate tamaa yako. Utiririshaji wa picha na video za ngono ni wa kutegemeza sana na umewashikwa wengi. Promise Keepers alisema asilimia 65 ya wanaume katika utafiti wao walikuwa wamegandamizwa. Uenezaji wa picha za ngono unafananishwa na pombe au madawa. Wanatuambia kwamba ubongo unataka endorphins zitolewe ndani yake, iwe kutokana na uraibu wa pombe, madawa, au picha za ngono. Ninaeleza tena kwamba wanaume na wanawake wanaofika kuwa wa kushinda watakuwa wale ambao, kama Daniel wa zamani, watakubali moyoni mwao, wasajisababishaji uchafu.

Mada hii pia ni kwa dada zetu, na maswali machache yanayofaa. Kuna nini ndani ya maisha yako kilichofungwa vizuri na kufichwa? Je, kukatishwa tamaa kwa maisha kumesababisha utupu unaofanya kuchukua 'Tylenol ya hisia' kukufanya uhisi vizuri kwa muda mfupi? Je, uhusiano wako wa kihisia uko salama mahali Mungu alikusudia kuweka?

Wasichana wadogo wanapaswa kufundishwa kuendeleza hifadhi yenye afya kwa wanaume. Sio kwa mtazamo wa kiburi na kamwe bila tabasamu, lakini pia sio kuwa huru kupita kiasi katika kuhusiana na wavulana. Jamii yetu imepangwa kinyume kabisa, na kuanzia chekechea, wavulana na wasichana wanatajwa kuhusu urafiki maalum. Kwa matokeo, watoto hukua wakiwa na uhifadhi mdogo au bila kabisa. Kujumuika kwa ujumbe kati ya jinsia tofauti kunapaswa kuepukwa nje ya uhusiano wa kifamilia. Hii itakuza tabia kwa vijana ambayo siku moja itabidi ivunjwe ikiwa wanatarajia kuishi maisha ya uwazi na mke/mume. Fikiria hivi: ungependa mwenzi wako kujumuika na jinsia ya kinyume kwenye mitandao ya kijamii?

Dada, kuwa makini na vitabu unavyosoma. Riwaya za kimapenzi hupunguza hamu ya Neno la Mungu na kutoa matarajio yasiyo halisi ya maisha ya ndoa. Vitabu hivi vinatoa wazo kwamba mwanaume sahihi mahali fulani atakuwa ufunguo wako wa kutimizwa na furaha maishani. Ni Yesu pekee ndiye anaweza kujaza shimo ambalo dhambi imeleta kwa kila binadamu leo. Hakuna mwanaume au mwanamke atakayewahi kuweza kutoa usalama na utulivu wa nafsi tunayotaka sana. Maumivu haya moyoni hayataguzwa na kile kinachofungwa kwa banda au vidonge vya maumivu. Husaidia kwa muda tu, na vinapotoweka, kilio cha moyo kinakuwa kwa sauti kubwa zaidi. Vitabu zisizofaa hupunguza tamu ya vitu vya Mungu, na badala yake huunda hamu ya vyakula vya taka na vidonge vya maumivu.

Tatizo jingine kwa dada ni kiasi cha muda unaotumia mtandaoni. Hakuna mwisho wa kutosheleza tamaa ya umaridadi, kipekee, mvuto, na uzuri. Usiruhusu mambo haya kuwa nguvu inayoendesha maisha yako kwa kuwa hayatatafuta kamwe 'sawa' na hayatatoa chochote kukidhi nafsi au kumwelekeza watoto wako kwa njia sahihi. Fikiria kiasi cha wakati unaotumia kuandaa sherehe. Kwa miaka, nimeona majina yanakuja na kupita ya fursa za biashara na bidhaa zinazopaswa kuwa nazo. Lakini kwa huzuni, katika miaka michache, hatuwezi hata kukumbuka yale majina wakati watoto walikuwa wakikua na sasa ni watu wazima. Fikiria mahitaji halisi katika maisha yako na wajibu wako, kisha uamue ni yapi yatakayoweka uwekezaji wa milele. Wanawake wenye watoto wanahitaji kupunguza vishawishi vinavyowafurahisha mno kwa sababu, kwa sasa, wamebarikiwa na watoto wenye roho zisizo za kifo na muda pamoja nao ni uwekezaji wa milele. Kumbuka kwamba mumeo na watoto wako wanastahili zaidi wakati wako kuliko kutumia masaa kwenye sherehe nyingine.

How can we live a morally pure life?

Be Humble. James 5 says, “Confess your faults one to another that ye may be healed.” It takes humility and brokenness to acknowledge our needs, but brokenness is the key to victory. I Peter 5:5 tells us that God gives grace to the humble. One of the most comprehensive definitions of grace is unmerited divine assistance given to humans for regeneration and sanctification. Regeneration is 'redeeming grace,' and sanctification is 'transforming grace.' The truth of this is that God gives 'transforming grace' to the humble. This grace changes us from the inside out making us holy. This aspect of grace must be desired and sought after as much as redeeming grace was when God saved us. This is probably the single most important step in overcoming addictions of any kind. Be humble enough to make it a daily prayer to God for His transforming grace. Jesus taught in Matthew 23:26, where He said, "First clean the inside of the cup, so that the outside may be clean also."

Be Honest. Examine your thoughts, actions, temptations, the things you struggle with, anger, lust, pride, bitterness, etc. Are you as spiritual as you portray yourself to be on the outside? Strip the veneer and admit the need for help.

Be transparent. Romans 2:16 tells of the day when God will judge the secrets of men. We are so foolish to think we can hide evil. We can hide for a while, but someday our actions will stand naked before an all-knowing God. Why would we try to hide something now? Those hidden things can be sent before to judgment, and a guilt-free life can be a reality today. Be transparent; it must be a working goal.

Tell yourself the truth. When you are tempted, consider the end of your lustful desire. Will you get what you want? Will this craving be satisfied, or will it only crave more? If you saw your brother doing what you are going after, how would it look? How will it look thirty years down the road if you follow your evil desire? Will it bring joy or sorrow? Will it be a help to someone, or will someone else be scared? Tell yourself the truth before you become intoxicated and unable to make rational judgments.

Teach your eyes to bounce. You can't help what you look at the first time, but you can control what you look at twice. Make it a practice till it becomes a habit to turn your eyes in a different direction whenever you see a sight that leads to impure thoughts.

Teaching our children. This should be heavy on our hearts from early childhood. If we don’t teach our children that God made us in the image of Himself, which needs to be kept pure, someone else will teach them to be secretive and make them feel impure. Stay close to your children and teach them as they mature.

Keep your emotions. This is a safety in our corrupt society. The further you get from this, the more vulnerable you will be to corruption. Keep your spouse first in life, the one you share with and are tied to emotionally.

Flee lust and fornication. Run from it! These cravings are addictions that must be broken. Remember, what you feed grows, and what you starve dies. These addictions can be broken, but you will need to feed the relationships that God has given and starve the hurtful ones.

Mungu ametuumba kwa njia kwamba tunapopenda vitu ambavyo yeye anavipenda, moyo wetu bado una nafasi ya kupenda zaidi. Haijalishi watoto wangapi, wajukuu wangapi, au marafiki wema wangapi tunao, mioyo yetu bado ina nafasi ya kupenda zaidi. Lakini mara tu tunapoanza kupenda kile Mungu amezuia, huanza kuchukua nafasi na kuharibu mapenzi mengine yote, kujaza mioyo yetu kwa utupu, maumivu, na upweke, ambayo huishia kwa mwisho wa uchungu.

Mwanaume wengi waliamka na kuona upumbavu wa njia aliyoichukua. Wengine walijaribu kuficha mwenendo usio wa mungu na walifanikiwa hadi mwisho wa maisha. Wengine walihifadhi siri zao hadi baada ya kufa. Swali la kutafakari, Je, ilistahili? Bila shaka, jibu ni HAPANA kwa sauti kubwa!

Ni upendo gani kuishi maisha wazi bila hatia na kuwa na amani na Mungu na uhakika wa dhambi zilizokombolewa, ili siku moja tutoke katika ulimwengu huu mbaya na kupelekwa mahali pa Mungu wetu Mtakatifu.

Two forces lie within my breast,
The one I love, the one I hate.
But the one I feed will dominate.

—The author’s dad

The more honestly I name
what is true about myself,
The less I need to hide and defend,
and posture and pretend.

—Dan Allender
result.title: Mwenye Maadili Safi Katika Jamii Iliyochafuka
